1384790379149598720.a: I find it amusing seeing radio people up in arms over sloppy Baofeng radios and spurious SDR emissions. Imagine every city filled with thousands of 50W, 100W, 500W transmitters with almost no filtering at 300-1000ft. Every city in the 1990s. <$1000 radios couldn't receive at all.

1384790380089122816.a: I never witnessed a commercial repeater with an actual circulator on the transmitter. I purchased one once in 1995 but had to throw away the circulator because they are single frequency. Without one, power amps will ingest signals from their antenna, amplify them, and retransmit.

1384790381129314305.a: People would obsess over the Intermodulation Distortion of their radio's receiver and claim theirs was the best. Nope. We were told obsessively the intermod is inside our receivers. Sometimes but much of it was happening inside these massive repeater farms with garbage equipment.
